title: Song Bie (Farewell)
attribution: Chinese farewell song with words written about 1915 by Li Shutong (Master Hongyi, died 1942) to the melody of John P. Ordway's "Dreaming of Home and Mother" (published 1868; Ordway died in 1880), in the simplified form of the 1907 Japanese school song "Ryoshū" by Kyūkei Indō (died 1943). The words were printed in 1927. Melody and words are public domain.
